blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh kis qisam ka sawal hai. Equation mein ek taraf trigonometric term \(3\sin x\) hai aur doosri taraf seedhi line wali term \(\frac{x}{2} + 1\). Aisi mili-juli equation kisi identity se exact solve nahi hoti, is liye kitab kehti hai: graph se solve karo.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur interval \([-\pi, \pi]\).
Find kya karna hai? Is interval ke woh saare \(x\) jahan dono graphs \(y = 3\sin x\) aur \(y = \frac{x}{2} + 1\) ek doosre ko kaatte hain.
Plan: pehle dono graphs ki shakal samjhenge, phir table of values, phir graph bana kar crossing points parhenge, aakhir mein 2 decimal tak pakka kar ke check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(3\sin x = \frac{x}{2} + 1\), \(x \in [-\pi, \pi]\).
Maloom karna: interval ke woh saare \(x\) jo equation ko poora karte hain.
Tareeqa: Graphical solution (Section 10.2). Dono sides ko alag alag functions bana kar ek hi axes par plot karte hain: \(y = 3\sin x\) aur \(y = \frac{x}{2} + 1\). Jahan dono graphs milte hain (intersection point), us point ka x-coordinate equation ka root hota hai. Crossing ki jagah pakarne ke liye hum farq \(d = 3\sin x - (\frac{x}{2} + 1)\) dekhte hain: jahan \(d\) ka sign badle (plus se minus ya minus se plus), wahan graphs ne ek doosre ko cross kiya hai.

Har graph ki shakal
\(y = 3\sin x\): yeh sine curve hai jis ki amplitude (oonchai ki had) 3 hai, yani yeh 3 se ooper aur \(-3\) se neeche nahi jata. \(x = -\pi, 0, \pi\) par yeh 0 hai, \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par sab se ooncha (3) aur \(x = -\frac{\pi}{2}\) par sab se neecha (\(-3\)).
\(y = \frac{x}{2} + 1\): yeh seedhi line hai, slope \(\frac{1}{2}\) aur y-intercept 1. \(x = -\pi\) par \(-0.57\) aur \(x = \pi\) par \(2.57\).
Kyun: Graph banane se pehle shakal pata ho to andaza ho jata hai ke line curve ko kitni dafa aur kahan kaat sakti hai. Yeh aisa hai jaise safar se pehle naqsha dekh lena.

Table of values (calculator radian mode mein, 2 decimal)
\(x = -\pi\): \(3\sin x = 0\), \(\frac{x}{2} + 1 = -0.57\), \(d = 0.57\)
\(x = -2.5\): \(-1.80\), \(-0.25\), \(d = -1.55\)
\(x = 0\): \(0\), \(1\), \(d = -1\)
\(x = 0.5\): \(1.44\), \(1.25\), \(d = 0.19\)
\(x = 2\): \(2.73\), \(2\), \(d = 0.73\)
\(x = 2.5\): \(1.80\), \(2.25\), \(d = -0.45\)
\(x = \pi\): \(0\), \(2.57\), \(d = -2.57\)
Kyun: \(d\) ka sign teen jagah badalta hai: \(-\pi\) aur \(-2.5\) ke darmiyan, 0 aur 0.5 ke darmiyan, aur 2 aur 2.5 ke darmiyan. Har sign change ka matlab hai ke ek graph doosre ke ooper se neeche (ya neeche se ooper) chala gaya, yani beech mein crossing hui. Is liye teen roots hain.
Dhyan dein: Calculator degree mode mein ho to saari values ghalat aayengi; yahan \(x\) radians mein hai.

Graph bana kar intersections parhein
Points plot karein, sine wale points ko smooth curve se jorein aur line kheenchein (figure dekhiye). Graphs in jagahon par milte hain:
\[x \approx -2.98,\ 0.41,\ 2.33\]
Kyun: Intersection point dono graphs par hota hai, is liye us ke x-coordinate par \(3\sin x\) aur \(\frac{x}{2} + 1\) ki value barabar hoti hai, yani equation poori hoti hai.

Har reading ko 2 decimal tak pakka karein
\(d(-2.985) = +0.025\), \(d(-2.975) = -0.010\)
\(d(0.405) = -0.020\), \(d(0.415) = +0.002\)
\(d(2.325) = +0.024\), \(d(2.335) = -0.002\)
Kyun: Haath se bana graph aam tor par ek decimal tak hi sahi parha jata hai. Doosra decimal pakka karne ke liye reading ke dono taraf aadhe qadam (0.005) par \(d\) nikalte hain. Agar dono values ke sign mukhtalif hon to root unhi ke beech hai, aur rounding se \(-2.98\), \(0.41\), \(2.33\) milte hain. Kitab ka Note bhi yahi kehta hai ke exact values numerical methods se behtar ki ja sakti hain.

Tasdeeq
\(x = -2.98\): \(3\sin x = -0.483\), \(\frac{x}{2} + 1 = -0.490\)
\(x = 0.41\): \(1.196\) aur \(1.205\)
\(x = 2.33\): \(2.176\) aur \(2.165\)
Kyun: Har root par dono sides takreeban 0.01 tak barabar hain. Rounded jawab mein itna sa farq hona normal hai, is liye teeno roots sahi hain.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x \approx -2.98,\ 0.41,\ 2.33\) radians
Yani interval \([-\pi, \pi]\) mein is equation ke teen roots hain.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = 3 sin x (blue sine curve, from 0 at minus pi down to minus 3, up to 3 and back to 0 at pi) and the straight line y = x/2 + 1 (pink) on the interval from minus pi to pi. They meet at three marked points, at x about minus 2.98, 0.41 and 2.33, with dashed lines dropped to the x-axis.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(x = -2.97\), \(0.41\) aur \(2.33\) radians likha hai. Pehla root asal mein \(x = -2.9779\ldots\) hai: \(d(-2.985) = +0.025\) aur \(d(-2.975) = -0.010\), is liye round karne par \(-2.98\) banta hai, \(-2.97\) nahi. Sahi jawab: \(x \approx -2.98,\ 0.41,\ 2.33\) radians.
